messages:
tanya: running into dup uploads in the android sample when token expires mid-upload (API 30). server logs show two POSTs for same upload id.
anil: is your refresh happening inside an Interceptor or an Authenticator?
tanya: interceptor. we do runBlocking to call authApi.refresh() then proceed with chain.proceed().
maria: runBlocking inside interceptor = recipe for disaster. it blocks the call thread and can cause reentrancy with the same client, or cause multiple calls to proceed if dispatcher threads are saturated.
kevin: +1. also multipart RequestBody is not guaranteed to be replayable. if you trigger a retry/proceed, the body may be streamed twice unexpectedly.
tanya: quick repro log: 
  --> POST /upload (multipart)
  <-- 401
  interceptor: refreshing token (runBlocking)
  --> POST /upload (Authorization: Bearer new)
  server: duplicate id 0x9f4b - rejected

anil: fix options: 1) use OkHttp.Authenticator for 401 -> build a new request, 2) perform refresh with a separate OkHttpClient (separate dispatcher & connection pool), or 3) coordinate refresh at TokenProvider level so only one refresh happens and others wait.
maria: for Kotlin coroutines prefer a suspend-friendly TokenProvider that exposes a Deferred/CompletableDeferred so waiters suspend without blocking the OkHttp thread. also create an authClient used only for refresh calls.
kevin: and for uploads recommend an idempotency key header so server can dedupe if duplicate body arrives. makes migration safer.
tanya: i'll implement an authClient + CompletableDeferred token provider and add a small sample in devex/samples/android. can someone review the snippet once I open the PR?
anil: happy to. also add a line in the README: "do not call main Retrofit client from interceptor for token refresh" and link to Authenticator example.
ci-bot: created issue DEVEX-3301: "android: prevent duplicate upload during token refresh - sample + docs"
tanya: thanks all :thumbsup:
